subject: DPA execution, subprocessor list & audit evidence — signoff request
messages:
From: Patricia Gomez <pgomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: VendorSecurity <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood DPA + subprocessor list + audit materials

Diego —

Thanks for the call earlier. Legal at Acme has a couple of final asks before we can push the DPA live and sign via DocuSign:

1) Confirm final executed DPA (we received v3 with a handful of redlines). Please confirm which document you'll sign.
2) Provide the current subprocessor roster and indicate which subprocessors process EU data vs US-only. We need an exportable list.
3) Audit evidence: we require the latest SOC 2 Type II attestation and a short pen-test executive summary (not the full report). Those are required for our InfoSec checklist.
4) Audit rights clause — our security team wants confirmation that you accept our limited audit playbook (scoped, non-invasive, with 30 days' notice).

Can you share the items this week? We aim to complete procurement and have DPA signed by 8/27 to meet our onboarding window.

Patricia
Patricia Gomez
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Acme Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <pgomez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood DPA + subprocessor list + audit materials

Team — forwarding Acme's thread. They want signoff and evidence by EOD Friday (8/27).

Key asks:
- Which DPA doc are we comfortable executing? They reference our v3 with redlines attached.
- Exportable subprocessor list (CSV) with data residency flags (EU/UK/US).
- SOC 2 Type II summary + pen-test exec summary. We can provide summary PDFs and a scoped audit playbook acceptance note.

I attached our proposed redlines (redlines-dpa-ACME-v3.docx) and the latest subprocessor export (subprocessor-export-2026-08.csv). Can you review clauses: 6.2 (audit rights), 9.3 (cross-border transfers), and 14.1 (indemnity/limitations) — these are the sticking points they flagged.

If we can accept a limited audit playbook (we do for most customers), let's finalize language and prep DocuSign envelope.

Thanks — Diego
--
Diego Fernandez
Head of Legal Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <pgomez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:27:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA + subprocessor list + audit materials

Diego / Kimberly / Patricia —

Thanks — I reviewed the redlines and talked to Security about the audit request. Summary of recommended approach:

- DPA execution: We can sign v3 with non-material language tweaks. I've proposed a short addendum that narrows audit rights to: (a) a single annual audit or questionnaire; (b) on-site only if mutually agreed and limited to SOC 2 scope; (c) 30 days' notice plus redaction rights. This mirrors our standard enterprise playbook. See attached redlines (redlines-dpa-ACME-v3.docx).

- Subprocessors: subprocessor-export-2026-08.csv is attached. Column headers include: name, service, region_of_processing (EU/US/APAC), data_types, and last_assessed. For Acme's needs, we flagged three EU processors (FastKV EU, VectorStore EU, Analytics EU). We recommend disclosure and offer to run a subprocessors briefing call if they'd like more detail.

- Evidence: SOC2-TypeII-2025-summary.pdf and pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (executive summary only) are attached. We will not share the full internal pentest artefacts; that's standard. The SOC 2 cover letter indicates scope and period (Jan–Dec 2025).

- Cross-border transfers: We will execute our standard EU transfer mechanism (SCCs plus controller-to-processor addendum if required). If Acme requires signed SCCs, we will route via our legal team but can include the SCC annex in the DocuSign packet.

Action items:
- Kimberly: finalize the DPA addendum language and confirm if we're comfortable with their limited audit playbook.
- Diego: prepare DocuSign envelope and package (DPA, SCCs, evidence PDFs, subprocessor CSV).

Patricia — happy to hop on a 30-minute call if you want to walk through the evidence.

Regards,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-2025-summary.pdf; pen-test-summary-2025.pdf; subprocessor-export-2026-08.csv; redlines-dpa-ACME-v3.docx
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Patricia Gomez <pgomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Redwood DPA + subprocessor list + audit materials — DocuSign packet sent

Patricia —

Thanks for the patience. Per our thread: we accepted the limited audit playbook proposed by your team subject to minor clarifications in clause 6.2 (redlines attached). We've packaged the executed DPA (v3 with agreed addendum), SCC annex, subprocessor roster, SOC 2 Type II executive summary, and pen-test executive summary into a single DocuSign envelope.

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/0X9Z
Envelope contents (attached): docusign-envelope-0X9Z.pdf (packet index)

Notes:
- The subprocessor CSV flags three EU processors and includes last_assessed dates. We will notify impacted subprocessors per our notice policy if you require additional technical details.
- SOC 2 summary covers Jan–Dec 2025; contact Soojin if your security team needs clarifications on control mappings.
- Pen test summary is a 2-page executive write-up — we do not provide raw test cases or exploit proof-of-concept.

If you're ready, please complete the DocuSign signature flow and let me know once signed. I'll share the executed PDF and kick off onboarding.

Best,
Diego
